title: ObjectGenome canonical free-form string byte budget
objective: Close the retained ObjectGenome free-form string memory/fingerprint-work gap without silently breaking established v1 recipe compatibility. Bound canonical provenance and component-role text using an explicit compatibility/versioning decision, then reject over-budget inputs before retained clone/fingerprint work.
acceptance: do not reuse the StableId semantic-key ceiling for free-form text without an explicit compatibility rationale
make the v1 compatibility/versioning decision explicit before tightening any currently accepted canonical recipe
apply a documented byte ceiling and/or aggregate canonical free-form byte envelope to provenance.manufacturerFamily, provenance.productLine, provenance.apparentEra, and component.role
reject over-budget canonical text before recipe cloning or recipeFingerprint chunk traversal can perform caller-sized retained work
cover every bounded field plus any aggregate envelope at exact-bound and +1 boundaries
preserve deterministic recipe fingerprint behavior for accepted recipes and verify constructor/inspect/fingerprint failure is fail-closed and non-mutating
remain distinct from HG-BACKFILL-OBJECTGENOME-STATE-BOUNDS collection cardinality and mutable-state breadth work
no Studio, viewport, persistence, networking, or physical evidence claim
notes: Proposed from capacity-mining finding evt-20260812t084600z-r7m4k9q2-objectgenome-string-bounds against retained generation-8 PR #395 head ebfd17e7a2d5cf2083b90e0122b70bc5c39d0962. Current source bounds StableId/semantic-key strings but validates provenance.manufacturerFamily/productLine/apparentEra and component.role only as non-empty strings; recipeFingerprint consumes full string bytes in 384-byte chunks and canonical cloning retains them. Existing tests intentionally accept a 1,025-byte productLine, so this cannot be treated as a trivial 512-byte semantic-key cleanup. Keep PROPOSED until HG-BACKFILL-OBJECTGENOME retained source can integrate and scheduler explicitly unlocks this leaf.
